verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes an official GitHub repo, snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs, whose OpenAPI-compliant specification files plus importable Postman collections can be downloaded. The REST API docs separately confirm that integrations are built from these openAPI specifications. The probe's 404s on guessed docs-domain paths do not contradict this, since the specs are hosted on GitHub rather than at a well-known URL. Missing for 10: a discoverable spec at a standard /openapi.json or .well-known path, explicit confirmation that the SQL API is covered by the published specs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the specs' completeness.
